programs.title: PAW Patrol
programs.sub_title: Mighty Pups vs. The Mayor of the Universe
programs.desc: Liberty and the Poms team up with the Mighty Pups to save Adventure Bay from being crushed by a giant, flying Top Hat.

programs.title: PAW Patrol
programs.sub_title: Pups Save the Alien Grandpa; Pups Save a Lemon-Loving Ducklin
programs.desc: Cap'n Turbot speaks fluent alien while stranded with an Alien Grandpa; a lemon-loving duckling from Yumi's Farm disrupts a delivery to Lizzy's Lemonade Shoppe.

programs.title: PAW Patrol
programs.sub_title: Pups Save a Hum-Kicker; Pups Save the One-Man Band
programs.desc: Mayor Humdinger turns up the power on his robotic soccer cleats, the "Hum-Kickers", and starts wrecking the town; Francois causes musical mayhem, as a one-man band, when he plans a special song for Wally's birthday.

programs.title: Mr. Crocodile
programs.desc: Toothy, lovable Mr. Crocodile, with his best friend Daisy by his side, navigates the human world in a series of zany adventures.

programs.title: PAW Patrol
programs.sub_title: Search and Rescue: Pups Save a Snack-Snatcher
programs.desc: When the Adventure Bay potluck food goes missing, the Search and Rescue pups deputize the whole community to track it down.

programs.title: PAW Patrol
programs.sub_title: Pups Save a Sweet Mayor; Pups Save a Magic Trick
programs.desc: Encased in a huge chocolate bunny, Humdinger is carried away by hungry raccoons; when a magic trick goes awry, the Adventure Bay Easter Festival is overrun by wild bunnies.

programs.title: PAW Patrol
programs.sub_title: Fire Rescue: Pups Save Lizzy's Lemonade Blaze
programs.desc: Mayor Humdinger and his kitties accidentally set Lizzy's Lemonade Stand and parts of Foggy Bottom ablaze; it's up to the pups to extinguish the fires.

programs.title: PAW Patrol
programs.sub_title: Search and Rescue: Pups Save a Swept-Away Sweetheart; Search and Rescue: Mystery of the Missing Kitties
programs.desc: Ms. Marjorie is paddleboarding out to celebrate her anniversary with Hurricane Harrigan on Seal Island when she disappears!; Mayor Humdinger can't find his kitties, so he runs to the Safety and Rescue Pups for help!

programs.title: PAW Patrol
programs.sub_title: Pups Save a Jukebox; Pups Save a Mayor on a Wire
programs.desc: Mayor Humdinger steals a jukebox so he can play an annoying song all day long, but Chase and Rubble track it down to save the records; a hungry eagle causes Mayor Goodway's tightrope walking lesson to go awry, sending her down Jake's Mountain.

programs.title: PAW Patrol
programs.sub_title: Pups Save Katie and Some Kitties; Pups Save a Helo Humdinger
programs.desc: When Mayor Humdinger tricks Katie into watching his kitties, an alarm system is set off and the PAW Patrol must rescue them; when Mayor Humdinger swipes one of Ryder's early inventions he must be rescued from an out-of-control flight.

programs.title: The Smurfs
programs.sub_title: Bee My Friend; Papa's Birthday Gift
programs.desc: When a bee chooses Blossom as its new queen, she needs Lily's help finding the bee's hive; Papa Smurf doesn't like his birthday gift from Dimwitty and Begonia and pretends to lose it.

programs.title: Sonic Prime
programs.desc: Sonic must learn to give up some control if he's going to defeat Nine on the battlefield; the first step is letting the team take over.
